results.title: Optimizing the quality of Islamic Senior High School ...
results.content: Therefore, implementing a vocational program curriculum in Islamic Senior High School is a viable alternative to equip students with vocational skills even if they cannot pursue higher education (Rios et al., Citation2020). Determination of research subjects using purposive techniques (Andrade, Citation2021; Campbell et al., Citation2020), such as considering the understanding and direct involvement of the subjects to be studied with the curriculum management process of vocational programs in Islamic Senior High School. The curriculum design of vocational programs in Islamic Senior High School in East Java is motivated because many graduate students still need help to continue their education at universities, and some become unemployed. This effort is a form of Islamic Senior High School effort in determining the appropriate integrated education model, especially the design of the vocational curriculum in pesantren-based Islamic Senior High Schools is developed integratively in every scope of learning materials in Islamic Senior High Schools and pesantren activities in order to realize education with character and skill development according to the potential of students.
